name: Astranaar
summary: Across its island in central Ashenvale, Astranaar offers refuge to Alliance travelers as threats gather in the forest. The old forest road runs beside the settlement, where furbolgs, satyrs, and the Horde endanger the Night Elves’ hold.

sections.title: Heart of the Forest
sections.body: Wooden footbridges lead from Astranaar’s island to the mainland across the forest lake. This is Ashenvale’s largest night elven settlement, where sentinels, priests, and artisans watch over the woodland. Travelers can find an inn, traders, and an expert leatherworker. From the high perches, a flight master sends hippogryphs to distant outposts across Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Bastion Under Siege
sections.body: Lanterns shine over Astranaar’s quiet waters, yet the town stays ready for attack. Raene Wolfrunner and other local leaders direct patrols and defenses against the corrupted Thistlefur furbolgs advancing from the north. The Sentinels fear the furbolgs may assault the settlement.

faq.q: What services are available in Astranaar?
faq.answer: Astranaar has an inn, general goods vendors, an expert leatherworking trainer, and a flight master with routes to key outposts across Ashenvale and Kalimdor.

faq.q: Who is buried in the graveyard across the lake?
faq.answer: No account from this era names who rests in the cemetery across the lake from Astranaar. The graves keep their secrets.

faq.q: Why are the Sentinels in Astranaar worried about the local furbolgs?
faq.answer: The Thistlefur furbolgs to the north have fallen under dark, corrupting influences. Sentinel Raene Wolfrunner fears their growing aggression may lead them to attack Astranaar.

faq.q: Can Horde players visit Astranaar safely?
faq.answer: No. Armed Night Elf Sentinels guard Astranaar, a fortified Alliance stronghold, and attack Horde members on sight.

angles.text: As a Kaldorei, you know Astranaar guards your ancient homeland in central Kalimdor and its sacred groves against growing threats in the forest.
As an Alliance member, you can look to Astranaar as a command post and logistical hub in Ashenvale’s contested wilderness.
